when_to_use: 结构化数据的行列展示
prompt_en: Build a single Data Table, not a full page. Structure: a four-column table (name, size, status, date) with a header row, five data rows, zebra or divider styling, and one row selected. Interaction: click a row to select (single), hover highlights rows, header click flashes sort direction on one column. States: header, row hover, row selected, status chip per row. Motion: 100ms row highlight. Do not add pagination. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个数据表格，不是整页。结构：四列表格（名称、大小、状态、日期），表头行 + 五行数据，斑马或分隔线样式，一行处于选中态。交互：点行单选，悬停高亮，点一次表头闪示某列排序方向。状态：表头、行悬停、行选中、每行状态小片。动效：100ms 行高亮。不要加分页。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 按时间顺序展示事件流
prompt_en: Build a single Timeline, not a full page. Structure: a vertical line with four event nodes, each node a dot (latest accent-colored) with a title, one-line description and timestamp. Interaction: hover a node highlights its block. States: latest node, past nodes, hover. Motion: none required. Do not make it horizontally scrollable. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个时间线，不是整页。结构：纵向轴线带四个事件节点，每节点为圆点（最新为强调色）+ 标题、一行描述和时间戳。交互：悬停节点高亮其块。状态：最新节点、历史节点、悬停。动效：可无。不要做成横向滚动。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Stat Group row, not a full page. Structure: three inline stats separated by dividers, each with a muted label, a bold number, and a small delta arrow. Interaction: hover lifts each stat slightly. States: default, hover, positive/negative delta. Motion: 120ms hover lift. Do not use cards with borders — keep them inline. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个指标组行，不是整页。结构：三个并排指标用分隔线隔开，每个为灰标签 + 加粗数字 + 小涨跌箭头。交互：悬停时轻微上浮。状态：默认、悬停、正/负涨跌。动效：120ms 悬停上浮。不要用带边框的卡片——保持内联。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Descriptions List, not a full page. Structure: a bordered panel with label/value pairs arranged in two columns, labels muted and right-aligned. Interaction: hover a row tints it slightly. States: default, hover. Motion: none. Do not use a table element — use a definition-style layout. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个描述列表，不是整页。结构：带边框面板，标签/值对按两列排布，标签灰色右对齐。交互：悬停行轻微着色。状态：默认、悬停。动效：无。不要用 table 元素——用定义式布局。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Ranking List, not a full page. Structure: five rows each with a rank number (top three accent-colored), a name, a thin progress bar showing share, and a value. Interaction: hover highlights a row. States: top-3 rank styled, normal rank, hover. Motion: bars animate to width on mount. Do not add medal icons. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个排行榜，不是整页。结构：五行，每行名次数字（前三强调色）、名称、细占比进度条、数值。交互：悬停高亮该行。状态：前三名样式、普通名次、悬停。动效：进度条挂载时动画到宽度。不要用奖牌图标。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 无图表库的轻量柱状对比
prompt_en: Build a single Mini Bar Chart, not a full page. Structure: seven vertical bars from data with weekday labels below, the tallest bar accent-colored, others muted; a value tooltip shows on hover. Interaction: hover a bar shows its value above it. States: default, hover, max highlighted. Motion: bars grow from bottom on mount, 300ms. Do not use a chart library. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个迷你柱状图，不是整页。结构：按数据画七根纵向柱，下方星期标签，最高柱强调色其余灰色；悬停显示数值。交互：悬停柱上方浮出数值。状态：默认、悬停、最大值高亮。动效：挂载时柱子自底部生长 300ms。不要用图表库。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Code Block, not a full page. Structure: a dark-surface panel with a header row (language label + copy button) and four lines of pre-formatted code. Interaction: copy button writes the code and flashes 已复制. States: default, copied. Motion: 120ms copied feedback. Do not add syntax highlighting libraries — single-color code is fine. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个代码块，不是整页。结构：深色面板：头部行（语言标签 + 复制按钮）+ 四行预格式化代码。交互：复制按钮写入剪贴板并闪示「已复制」。状态：默认、已复制。动效：120ms 反馈。不要用语法高亮库——单色代码即可。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 多项占比/进度的纵向列表
prompt_en: Build a single Progress List, not a full page. Structure: four rows each with a label, a thin progress bar and a percentage; one row in danger color (nearly full). Interaction: hover shows exact value tooltip. States: normal bars, warning bar, hover. Motion: bars fill 400ms on mount. Do not use a donut chart. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个进度列表，不是整页。结构：四行，每行为标签 + 细进度条 + 百分比；一行接近满时用危险色。交互：悬停显示精确值 tooltip。状态：普通条、告警条、悬停。动效：挂载时 400ms 填充。不要用环形图。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 成员列表的堆叠头像展示
prompt_en: Build a single Avatar Group, not a full page. Structure: four overlapping circular monogram avatars with white rings, plus a final +N circle; hovering an avatar raises it slightly. Interaction: hover raises individual avatar, click flashes selection. States: stacked default, hover raised, overflow +N. Motion: 120ms raise. Do not use image assets — monograms are fine. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个头像组，不是整页。结构：四个堆叠重叠的圆形字母头像带白描边，末尾一个 +N 圆；悬停时单个头像轻微上浮。交互：悬停上浮单个头像，点击闪示选中。状态：堆叠默认、悬停上浮、溢出 +N。动效：120ms 上浮。不要用图片资源——字母即可。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 文件目录等层级数据展示
prompt_en: Build a single Tree List (read-only), not a full page. Structure: an indented list of three levels with carets for expand/collapse and file/folder glyphs, one leaf highlighted. Interaction: click carets to expand/collapse branches. States: expanded, collapsed, leaf hover, highlighted leaf. Motion: 150ms branch expand. Do not add checkboxes — it is read-only. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个层级列表（只读），不是整页。结构：三级缩进列表，带展开/收起箭头与文件/文件夹符号，一个叶子高亮。交互：点箭头展开/收起分支。状态：展开、收起、叶子悬停、叶子高亮。动效：150ms 分支展开。不要加勾选框——这是只读的。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 一组状态标签的图例展示
prompt_en: Build a single Status Badge Group, not a full page. Structure: a wrap row of five badges (成功, 处理中, 已排队, 失败, 已跳过) each with a leading status dot in semantic colors. Interaction: hover lifts each badge slightly. States: per-badge semantic color, hover. Motion: none. Do not make them interactive filters. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个状态徽章组，不是整页。结构：一行可换行的五个徽章（成功、处理中、已排队、失败、已跳过），每个带语义色状态圆点。交互：悬停轻微上浮。状态：各自语义色、悬停。动效：无。不要做成可交互筛选器。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。
